integrity: A symbolic all-n proof and two independent exhaustive small-n verifiers are provided. All claims and source comparisons are attributed without independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Theorem for synchronous open NOR on L(K_n), n>=3; no assertion for other update rules, other graphs, or nonuniform initial laws. The periodic-entry identity and fixed-state maximal matching criterion are known. Literature priority not absolute; independent validation not performed.
title: Matching-skeleton NOR dynamics on triangular graphs and a doubled rare-defect law
